title: Really great time
text: Concha was wonderful as a guide, and we enjoyed the entire tour while we were there. I personally really appreciated the down to earth anecdotes from more everyday people, as well as the little details in the streets she pointed out like the reused roman columns. It added so much context to the city and I think we would have enjoyed the trip a lot less if we didn’t go on this trip with her, so much thanks to Seville Unique Experiences and Concha for the trip
author: A2590LHcharlesl

author: X8140WCphilipb

title: Detailed and informative.
text: Miguel was a great tour guide. He provided a detailed history of the Jews of Seville. He spoke clearly and answered all questions. The tour took us around the centre of Seville to very scenic and old parts of the city in the Santa Cruz neighbourhood. Miguel's knowledge was excellent. It covered the relations between the Jews and various kings, and with non-Jewish communities.  It was at a very convenient pace. Highly recommended.
author: quartzi2015

title: Ask for Miguel
